note: Your approved affiliate links (free edition; the full platform manages them in Admin → Commerce). Add a link only after the programme has accepted you. Example entry: { "tool": "descript", "network": "partnerstack", "url": "https://get.descript.com/your-code" }. "tool" is the name of a file in data/tools without .json. Optional: "terms": "https://…" (the programme's terms page), "active": false (switch a link off), and {click_id} inside the url where the network accepts a sub-id. The link only changes the 'visit' button (/go/<tool>); rankings and comparisons never see this file. CI checks the file on every commit; the site uses the link from the next deploy.
